Guideline Name 
Systane, Refresh, Gonak, Genteal, Tears Naturale  
Formulary 
• 
Medicaid - Arizona (AZM, AZMREF, AZMDDD)  
 
 
Guideline Note: 
Effective Date: 
12/9/2021  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:brand Systane, brand Refresh, brand Gonak, brand Genteal, Tears Naturale  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - History of failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ALL of the following:  
• 
Generic equivalents for drops, ointments and gel formulations for Systane, Refresh, 
Gonak, Genteal, Tears Naturale, and Generic equivalent to the requested brand 
product  
• 
sodium chloride ophthalmic ointment
